## Page 20

Business Progress
1.In Q4/2025, Customers in Export Industries (ex. Automotive, Electronics,
Electrical appliances, etc.) had a better trend as more investment in Thailand 
through BOI.
2.In Q4/2025, purchasing power for local consumption had still maintained
at a low level as agricultural products price going down and cost of living 
rising.
3.   In Q4/2025, most of raw materials prices maintained as their supply 
returned to a normal.

## Page 21

Business Progress
4. In Q1/2026, export business (ex. Automotive, Electronics, Electrical 
appliances, etc.) was continuously in a good trend as more investment 
through BOI especially Electrical appliances and Electronic parts. 
5. In Q1/2026, the Company sell increasingly the products to some growing 
industries such as electronic and electrical appliances industry and to Chinese 
manufacturers who invested more in Thailand, especially in electrical 
appliances.
6. In Q1/2026, Local consumption had been in down trend as of the effects 
from slowing -down in Thailand economy and higher energy prices.

## Page 22

Effects from War
-Shortage of raw materials and increase in raw materials prices.
-Energy price would be heavily higher and would effect to transportation 
costs.
